readerAnswers.news: On September 9, HoneyBook announced a plugin that connects its client-management service to ChatGPT.
readerAnswers.mechanism: The boundary is read, draft, review, approve.
readerAnswers.limit: When connecting, you choose which HoneyBook resources it can reach, and you can disconnect it later in ChatGPT settings without changing your HoneyBook account.

terms.plugin: connects its client-management service to ChatGPT

explainBack: An existing HoneyBook user can ask ChatGPT about approved account records and prepare work, but the work stays a draft until she reviews and approves it.
unseenTransfer: For another connected service, ask separately what it can read, what it can prepare, and what it can change or send without another approval.
repairs: Used September 9 as the announcement date, explained the client-management connection, and kept resource selection, draft review and disconnect specific to HoneyBook.
limitations: Producer review is not independent admission.
No observed human-comprehension evidence is claimed.
Official product sources do not establish ChatGPT plan availability or real-account effectiveness.
